description: The body points both keys share: where an exercise key holds a load (after @ in l) and where the body bears weight on a support (after @ in s), and an equipment key's load interface (l).

entries.description: The hands, or one hand: a held implement, handles or a bar.
The forearms, elbows bent: an elbow plank, or a machine’s forearm pads.
The upper arms: a preacher pad, or a machine’s arm pad on the upper arm or elbow.
The shoulders: the front rack or one shoulder, or a machine’s shoulder pads.
The chest: a load held against it (goblet, bear hug), or a chest pad.
The back: a bar across the upper back (back squat), or a back pad.
The front of the hips: a load across them (hip thrust), or a machine’s hip pad or belt.
Hung from a belt at the waist.
The buttocks: sitting down onto a box or bench, or a machine’s moving seat.
On or around the thighs, or a machine’s thigh pad.
At or around the knees, or a machine’s knee pad or platform.
The calves (the back of the lower leg).
At or just above the ankles: a strap, a cuff, or a machine pad on the lower leg.
The feet, or one foot: on the floor, or on a foot plate or pedals.
The head or forehead, or a machine’s head pad.
